parsed_results.text: This is about running the job once, not doing more.
We retried failed notifications, not failed payments.
Unlike Lee et al. [4], we found no improvement in the smaller sample.
The deployment worked. My celebratory dance was undocumented.
The cache may reduce latency by ~10% for repeated requests; we haven't tested cold starts.
The tapestry depicts a coastal landscape.
Please send the invoice by Friday.
The team launched the dashboard on Tuesday.
The prototype aims to detect duplicate invoices. We have not tested its accuracy. It could help the finance team.
The vector represents velocity. The robust regression estimates the slope, limiting the effect of outliers.
The migration is complete. The manager said, 'Ready to launch.' We still need to check the backups.

On Tuesday, I helped deploy the cache to two servers. In our 30-minute test, median latency for repeated requests fell from 80 ms to 60 ms. We have not tested cold starts or the other eight servers. The dashboard still shows yesterday's data.

Before release:
- Verify the signature.
